README

Recorded documentation

Upstream documentation. Cargo examples describe the Rust crate; Add to project provides the Oven dependency.

README.md · Author-provided

NoOp proc macro

NoOp mocks for proc_macros that you might want to make optional.

#[cfg(feature = "serde")]
pub(crate) use serde_derive::{Serialize, Deserialize};

#[cfg(not(feature = "serde")]
pub(crate) use noop_proc_macro::{Serialize, Deserialize};

Supported proc_macros

  • Serde
  • rust-hawktracer
  • wasm_bindgen
